headline: Android Engineer
shortBio: Senior Android Engineer with 8 years of experience building, modernizing, and optimizing Android applications across e-commerce, telecommunications, and multimedia.
professionalProfile: A highly accomplished Senior Android Engineer with 8 years of profound experience in architecting, developing, and optimizing mobile applications across diverse sectors including e-commerce, telecommunications, and multimedia. Expertly s Kotlin and Jetpack Compose to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions, consistently driving innovation through advanced architectural patterns, Kotlin Multiplatform, and pioneering Agentic AI development. Currently applying cutting-edge skills in cross-platform development and AI-driven engineering workflows.

summaryOfQualifications.title: Core Expertise
summaryOfQualifications.description: Over 8 years of comprehensive experience in Android application development, specializing in Kotlin, Java, Jetpack Compose, and modern architectural patterns across multiple industry domains.

summaryOfQualifications.title: Technical Innovation
summaryOfQualifications.description: Pioneered the adoption and implementation of Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and Compose Multiplatform (CMP) to streamline cross-platform development and enhance code reusability.

summaryOfQualifications.title: AI Development
summaryOfQualifications.description: Championed Agentic Development methodologies, utilizing advanced AI tools (Cursor, Claude, AI Studio) to establish AI agent rules and custom skills, significantly boosting development efficiency and output.

summaryOfQualifications.title: System Architecture
summaryOfQualifications.description: Architected and transformed outdated monolithic codebases into modular, scalable systems, improving maintainability and optimizing performance for applications serving millions of users.

summaryOfQualifications.title: Product Impact
summaryOfQualifications.description: Directed the development and deployment of high-performance, user-centric mobile applications for major online retailers and creative platforms, impacting over a billion downloads globally.
